purpose: Executable ledger for the `composition-interface-global` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Interface-compatibility rows gate overlap, seam, boundary, shared-variable, dictionary, scale, detector/source, and public-record compatibility. They make local-to-local transfer explicit but do not establish global closure.

interface_rows.mismatch_residual: Unmatched variables, incompatible boundary/cutoff choices, conflicting gauge/frame conventions, nonshared priors, incompatible likelihood factors, or failed overlap maps remain residual debt.
